purpose: Define the immutable checks required before a separately approved review-admission milestone.
identityIntegrityRequirements: identityIntegrityManifestId matches the accepted side manifest
identityIntegrityManifestHash verifies against the manifest bytes
blankPacketHash verifies against the canonical blank packet bytes
reviewedPacketRequirements: reviewedPacketHash reproduces from canonical reviewed packet content
reviewed packet references the original blank packet ID and hash
reviewed packet references the identity-integrity manifest ID and hash
exact event identity reproduces byte-for-byte from the verified blank row
reviewed packet manifest hash verifies against the reviewed packet bytes
REJECT_EVENT_IDENTITY requires a founder rejection reason
SOURCE_BACKED_CLASSICAL_CANDIDATE requires source ID, edition, locator and event connection
rejections: classical claim without exact source references
